name: Maha Thammaracha
contribution: King of Ayutthaya from the Sukhothai dynasty, ruling from 1569 to 1590.

checks.lead: Maha Thammaracha, Maha Thammarachathirat, or Sanphet I, formerly known as Khun Phirenthorathep, was King of Ayutthaya from the Sukhothai dynasty, ruling from 1569 to 1590. As a powerful Sukhothai noble, Phirenthorathep gradually rose to power. After playing many political turns, he was eventually crowned as King of Ayutthaya.
